seo.title: A better path for Docker pulls
seo.description: A local, read-only registry mirror proxy for Docker. Manage upstreams, isolate failures, and resume interrupted layers.

home.title: Your mirrors.
home.description: Put your registry mirrors behind one local proxy. Automatically switch away from failures and resume interrupted layers. Copy, run, and start pulling.
home.verified: SHA256 checked · Your configuration stays yours

installNotes.linux: Paste into your terminal. Installs and starts a systemd/OpenRC service, then configures local Docker. Requests sudo for system changes; never restarts Docker.
installNotes.macos: Run as your Docker Desktop user. Installs a launchd system service and configures Docker Desktop. Requests sudo for system changes; follow any pending-restart instructions.
installNotes.windows: Run in PowerShell. Downloads the script, then installs a Windows service and configures Docker Desktop. Approve the administrator prompt; Docker is not restarted.
installNotes.freebsd: Installs the binary to /usr/local/bin without a service. Requires root or sudo if the directory is not writable. Start the proxy and configure Docker on its host using the installation guide.

home.nextTitle: Your next command is a Docker command.
home.nextText: Follow the installer output to finish activation. Once Docker is connected, keep using the commands you already know.
home.nextNote: Need a container deployment or a manual setup?

features.title: Upstreams, on your terms.
features.text: Add, remove, and disable mirrors without restarting dockerd.

features.title: Isolate failures. Keep pulling.
features.text: Circuit breakers take failing mirrors out of rotation until a probe succeeds.

features.title: Resume. Don’t restart.
features.text: Continue an interrupted layer from the same byte offset on another mirror.
